slide_title: Minimization of Objective function to obtain BEST model parameters

bullets: J(W)=1/2[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) − Y^T(XW) − (XW)^T Y]+1/2 λ W^T W
J(W)=1/2[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) − 2(XW)^T Y]+1/2 λ W^T W
Get Best W that minimizes the Objective Function J(W)
∂J(W)/∂W = 0 = 1/2[2X^T X W − 2 X^T Y]+λ I W
W = (X^T X + λ I)^(−1) X^T Y
equations: J(W) = \frac{1}{2}[Y^T Y + (XW)^T(XW) - Y^T(XW) - (XW)^T Y] + \frac{1}{2}\lambda W^T W
\frac{\partial J(W)}{\partial W} = 0 = \frac{1}{2}[2X^T X W - 2 X^T Y] + \lambda I W
